name: tic-tac-toe
title: Tic-Tac-Toe-Extreme
summary: Recursive tic-tac-toe — a 3x3 big board where each quadrant holds its own 3x3 board.

prefer: Fast isolated tests over pure logic — the rules engine, win and draw detection, send-to-quadrant, save/load round-trips. These hold most of the risk and are the cheapest to test.
Property/invariant tests for the rules engine: play many random legal games and assert what must never happen, rather than hand-picking boards.
Rendered-component tests only where a wrong guess is expensive — a tap changing game state, not how it looks.
avoid: Pixel-snapshot (golden) tests. Theming is still changing constantly, so every theme edit would invalidate them wholesale.
End-to-end tests on a simulator, until late. One smoke test once the app runs is worth more than a suite of them.
Any assertion about spacing, colour, easing, or feel — those are checked by running the app.
